meta.review_notes: Privacy policy URL unavailable (HTTP2 error). Analysis based on Terms of Use (65,160 chars) which contains some data practice information. Key findings: 2-year data deletion for inactive accounts, PAN card required for large purchases, content license granted to Myntra, some data shared with sellers and service providers.

app.name: Myntra - Fashion Shopping App
app.description: India's leading fashion and lifestyle shopping app for clothing, footwear, accessories and home furnishing for men, women and kids.

verdict.one_liner: Myntra's privacy policy is inaccessible, but their Terms of Use reveals broad content rights, data sharing with sellers, and PAN card collection for large purchases.
verdict.summary: Myntra's dedicated privacy policy could not be accessed, making it impossible to fully assess their data practices. However, their Terms of Use reveals concerning practices: you grant Myntra perpetual, worldwide rights to content you upload; your name and contact details are shared with sellers for customization services; PAN card copies are required for purchases over ₹2 lakh; and inactive accounts are deleted after 2 years. Without a proper privacy policy, important questions about data sharing, tracking, and user rights remain unanswered.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Myntra's privacy policy is inaccessible, so comprehensive data practices cannot be verified. Their Terms of Use grants them broad rights to your content and shares your data with third-party sellers. Consider shopping on platforms with transparent privacy policies.

red.title: Privacy policy inaccessible
red.plain_english: Myntra's privacy policy at myntra.com/privacypolicy is not accessible, so their complete data practices cannot be verified.

red.title: Broad content license granted
red.plain_english: When you upload content to Myntra, you grant them worldwide, perpetual, and transferable rights to use it for any purpose including promotional and advertising purposes.

red.title: Data shared with sellers
red.plain_english: For customization services, your name and contact details are shared with sellers or brands. You may also need to share additional personal data directly with sellers.

red.title: PAN card required for large purchases
red.plain_english: For purchases of ₹2 lakh or more, you must upload a scanned copy of your PAN card within 4 days or your order will be cancelled.

green.title: Inactive account data deleted
green.plain_english: If you don't access your account for 2 years, your data including transactional data will be deleted from their records.

green.title: No promotional phone calls
green.plain_english: Myntra states they will not use your personal information to initiate promotional phone calls or SMS.
